title: ocotea tonduzii
intro: Ocotea tonduzii, commonly known as Panama Red, is a plant species belonging to the Lauraceae family. This plant is traditionally used in medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Ocotea tonduzii involve its ability to reduce anxiety and stress, improve sleep quality, and support weight management. The bioactive constituents responsible for these effects include limonene, beta-caryophyllene, and other sesquiterpenes, which contribute to its therapeutic potential.
